capacity.below_floor: halt before prompt inference/scoring and return to design; do not retry to cross the floor
capacity.resolution: the fresh benchmark process resolves AUTO, creates its context, and executes the frozen item without a separate resolver
capacity.run_acceptance: accept every otherwise-valid completed run at its naturally resolved capacity when resolved_slots >= floor_slots

forbidden: retry to obtain a preferred capacity or cross the floor
page-cache, swap, cgroup, sysctl, reboot, or memory-pressure normalization
capacity-based completed-run selection, filtering, rebalancing, or rerun
pair_semantics: natural EXACT/S2 AUTO-capacity differences are retained and reported descriptively; they do not invalidate a pair or trigger retries

unchanged: paired-30 selection and complete S2 order
prompt, sampling, seed, context, generation, stop, and scoring semantics
durability, resume, campaign order, and no-quality-adaptation rules
